title: Cauliflower, parsnip and bacon hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Bacon, parsnips, cauliflower, onion, eggs, oil, herbs and smoked paprika are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan, a knife and a board, and the technique is simple frying.

works.reason: A whole cauliflower, three parsnips, six rashers and four eggs make a sensible lunch for four, and 25 minutes of frying will cook the diced veg through, though a big pan is needed to avoid steaming.

honest_times.reason: The steps add up to about 30 to 35 minutes on the hob (crisping the bacon, then 15 minutes, 10 minutes and 4 to 5 minutes), so the printed 25 minutes of cook time is too short.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, 'smoked bacon' matches the bacon id, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot cauliflower and parsnip hash suits a cold early-March lunch, and cauliflower is central to the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Plenty of vegetables, plus eggs and bacon for protein, make a satisfying family lunch.
